careerDirection.directionDescription: Accounting involves recording, classifying, and summarising financial transactions of an organisation. Professionals in this area maintain ledgers, prepare financial statements, manage accounts payable and receivable, process payroll, and ensure accurate reconciliation. These roles exist in every commercial organisation, making this the most consistent entry-level destination for commerce graduates.

careerDirection.directionDescription: Tax compliance covers filing of income tax returns, GST returns, TDS returns, and maintaining statutory records. Professionals in this space work in tax advisory firms, corporate tax departments, and CA offices assisting in direct and indirect tax matters. With GST firmly embedded in India's tax system, demand for tax associates and GST consultants at the entry level is consistently high.
